question: When endpoint-Jacobian modes are fit across both known constructions, do they close the task circuits on a wholly fresh matched lexicon, or is the remaining complement lexical/context-specific?

frozen_design.development_population: All jointly capable original has/had and is/was A1 and A2 rows already used by the circuit program; no fresh-v4 row enters a basis.
frozen_design.basis: For each retained component, use the complete relative-1e-6 span of answer-margin gradients at base and donor endpoints across both original constructions, unioned with static task weight-read modes.
frozen_design.fresh_population: All A1/A2 rows from fresh lexicon v4; capability selection requires at least 12 jointly capable rows and at least 6 per direction in every task/panel.

predictions.pred_a_authority_novelty_capability_proj: Authorities, fresh-row novelty, capability, projectors, coverage, finiteness and maximum price pass.
predictions.pred_b_full_programs_generalize: Full pruned-program recovery is at least 0.60 and donorward on every fresh task/panel.
predictions.pred_c_construction_complete_modes_are_s: Mode-union recovery is at least 0.95 of full-program recovery and donorward on every fresh task/panel.
predictions.pred_d_construction_complete_complements: Absolute complement recovery is at most 0.20 of full-program recovery on every fresh task/panel.
predictions.pred_e_mlp_modes_remain_compressive_with: Every MLP union rank is below 1152 and <=390 for has/had or <=119 for is/was; no fresh outcome selects modes and no model update occurs.

decision: screen seals a construction-complete transparent mode program; null distinguishes program non-transfer, mode insufficiency, or complement non-inertness without threshold repair; invalid on authority, novelty, capability, projection, coverage, finiteness, or price failure
